complaints.title: Pothole on Main Street
complaints.description: Large pothole on MG Road near the bus stop is causing accidents. Multiple vehicles have been damaged.

complaints.title: Street Light Not Working
complaints.description: The street light near Park Road junction has been off for 5 days causing safety concerns at night.

complaints.title: No Water Supply for 3 Days
complaints.description: Our entire apartment complex has had no water supply for 3 days. We have filed a complaint with BWSSB but no action taken.

complaints.title: Garbage Not Collected for a Week
complaints.description: Garbage collection has not happened in our locality for 7 days. The smell is unbearable and attracting stray animals.
